messages.subject: Unexplained warning message
parts:
Hello,


I have the following SEM model.


Data_sem_z<-read.csv(file.choose(),sep=";", header=T)
colnames(Data_sem_z)

X23HR1<-Data_sem_z$X23HR1

X24HR1plus<-Data_sem_z$X24HR1plus

X24FIN1plus<-Data_sem_z$X24FIN1plus


X24SUP1plus<-Data_sem_z$X24SUP1plus
X24SUP2plus<-Data_sem_z$X24SUP2plus


X24EDU1plus<-Data_sem_z$X24EDU1plus
X24EDU2plus<-Data_sem_z$X24EDU2plus


X25FIN1minus<-Data_sem_z$X25FIN1minus
X25FIN2minus<-Data_sem_z$X25FIN2minus
X25FIN3minus<-Data_sem_z$X25FIN3minus
X26FIN1minus<-Data_sem_z$X26FIN1minus
X26FIN2minus<-Data_sem_z$X26FIN2minus
X26FIN3minus<-Data_sem_z$X26FIN3minus


X25GOV1minus<-Data_sem_z$X25GOV1minus
X25GOV2minus<-Data_sem_z$X25GOV2minus
X26GOV1minus<-Data_sem_z$X26GOV1minus
X26GOV2minus<-Data_sem_z$X26GOV2minus
X26GOV3minus<-Data_sem_z$X26GOV3minus




modelZ <-'
# measurement model


COMP_ADV =~ X23INNOV1+X23INNOV2+X23SUP1+X23SUP2+X23HR1+X23HR2+X23HR3
SUPPLUS=~ X24SUP1plus+X24SUP2plus
HRPLUS=~ X24HR1plus+X24HR2plus+X24HR3plus+X24HR4plus+X24HR5plus
FMINUS=~ X25FIN1minus+X25FIN2minus+X25FIN3minus+X26FIN1minus+X26FIN2minus+X26FIN3minus
GOVMINUS=~ X25GOV1minus+X25GOV2minus+X26GOV1minus+X26GOV2minus+X26GOV3minus
EDUPLUS=~ X24EDU1plus+X24EDU2plus
# PLUS=~ SUPPLUS+HRPLUS
# MINUS=~ FMINUS+GOVMINUS
# regressions
COMP_ADV~EDUPLUS+SUPPLUS+HRPLUS+FMINUS+GOVMINUS
# residual correlations
#X23INNOV1~~X23INNOV2
#X23SUP1~~X23SUP2
#X23HR1~~X23HR2+X23HR3
#X24SUP1plus~~X24SUP2plus
#X24HR1plus~~X24HR2plus+X24HR3plus+X24HR4plus+X24HR5plus
#X25FIN1minus~~X25FIN2minus+X25FIN3minus+X26FIN1minus+X26FIN2minus+X26FIN3minus
#X25GOV1minus~~X25GOV2minus+X26GOV1minus+X26GOV2minus+ X26GOV3minus
'


fit_Z <- sem(modelZ, data=Data_sem_z)


error message:

Warning message:
In lav_object_post_check(lavobject) :
  lavaan WARNING: covariance matrix of latent variables
                is not positive definite;
                use inspect(fit,"cov.lv") to investigate.


semPaths(fit_Z, what='est',
edge.label.cex = 1,
node.label.cex=5,
curvePivot = TRUE,
fade=FALSE, style = "LISREL", layout="tree",exoCov=F, structural=F)


########################
fitMeasures(fit_Z, fit.measures = c("chisq", "df", "pvalue","ifi" ,"bic",
"cfi", "srmr","rmsea", "agfi"), baseline.model = NULL)

inspect(fit_Z, what="start")
inspect(fit_Z, "theta")

Error in UseMethod("inspect") : 
  no applicable method for 'inspect' applied to an object of class "lavaan"

I would really appreciate your help as I can't find any way to fix this problem.

Best wishes,

Kostas

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Unexplained warning message
parts:
error message:

Warning message:
In lav_object_post_check(lavobject) :
  lavaan WARNING: covariance matrix of latent variables
                is not positive definite;
                use inspect(fit,"cov.lv") to investigate.
This is not an error, it is a warning, and the message tells you how to investigate the potential problem (perhaps a Heywood case).

inspect(fit_Z, what="start")
inspect(fit_Z, "theta")

Error in UseMethod("inspect") : 
  no applicable method for 'inspect' applied to an object of class "lavaan"

I'm not sure if another package's inspect() method is overriding the lavaan one, but you can use lavInspect(fit_Z, "theta") instead, to avoid ambiguity.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
